items.title: Local SEO, plain English — Ep. 01: Name, address, phone
items.alt: Desanya Studio slide titled Local SEO, plain English, Episode 01, Name, address, phone. Large text reads "Same name. Same address. Same phone. Everywhere." Below: "When your business info matches on every listing, it's easier for Google to trust they're all the same business."
items.caption: Local SEO, plain English — Ep. 01: Name, address, phone

items.title: Local SEO, plain English, Episode 02: 7 Google Business Profile fields
items.alt: Desanya Studio slide for the Local SEO, plain English series, Episode 02, Google Business Profile. Large text reads "7 Google Business Profile fields worth filling in." Below: "A half-finished profile looks like a half-open business. Here's what to complete, in plain English." Swipe for all 7 fields.
items.caption: Local SEO, plain English, Episode 02: 7 Google Business Profile fields

frames.alt: Slide titled "What a Google Business Profile is: The box Google often shows first." Text explains that when you search for a business nearby, you often see a box before any website, with name, map pin, hours, photos and a call button, in Google Search and Maps, and that it's free. A checklist of what customers can do from that box: call you with one tap, check if you're open now, click through to your website, get directions to your door, read reviews, see photos of your work.
frames.caption: What a Google Business Profile is: the box Google often shows first, with name, map pin, hours, photos and a call button.

frames.alt: Slide titled "The 7 fields, part 1 of 2: Who you are and where you work," with four cards. Address or service area: your address if customers come to you, a service area like Knoxville or Maryville if you go to them. Business name: your real name, exactly as it's on your sign, no extra keywords, because that can get a profile suspended. Category: pick the main category that best describes what you do, then add secondary ones. Description: a plain-language summary of what you do, who you serve and where.
frames.caption: The 7 fields, part 1: address or service area, business name, category, and description.

frames.alt: Slide titled "The 7 fields, part 2 of 2: When to call and what you offer," with three cards. Hours: your regular hours, plus holiday hours when they change. Phone and website: use the same phone number that's on your website, and add your website link. Products or services: list each one with a short description. A tip card from episode 01: your name, address and phone should match everywhere you're listed.
frames.caption: The 7 fields, part 2: hours, phone and website, and products or services.

frames.alt: Slide titled "Bonus, photos: Real photos, not stock." Photos give people a reason to trust you before they ever meet you. List: examples of finished work, storefront or workspace, your products, your team. Add new ones as your business changes.
frames.caption: Bonus: real photos, not stock. Work, storefront or workspace, products, and team.

frames.alt: Slide titled "This week's fix: Finish your profile in four steps." 1, search your business name on Google, and claim and verify the profile if it isn't yours yet. 2, fill in all 7 fields, with the same name and phone number that's on your website. 3, add at least 3 real photos. 4, set your regular hours now and add holiday hours later, before they change.
frames.caption: This week's fix: claim the profile, fill in all 7 fields, add at least 3 real photos, and set regular hours.

frames.alt: Slide titled "Want it done for you? We'll set up your profile with you." Card: SEO & Google setup, $550, covering your Business Profile, search listings and basic on-site SEO, with every change drafted for your approval first. SEO & Google managing, $450 a month, for updates, visibility checks and light optimizations. Pink "Book an intro" button. Full guide: "Google Business Profile: the free tool most businesses ignore," on the desanya.tech blog.
frames.caption: Want it done for you? SEO & Google setup is $550. Managing is $450 a month.
